name: nexus
description: Portable team workflow for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes — not a host replacement.

interface.shortDescription: Portable workflow across agent hosts — not a host replacement
interface.longDescription: Nexus complements Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes with one shared workflow: choose main vs worktree, validate with evidence, run integrity review, then close out with commit, unify, and push — each step with explicit approval. Preferences live in ~/.nexus and per-repo .nexus/.
defaultPrompt: Implement this change with Nexus closeout.
Use integrity-review on the completed work.
